notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional Auto Provide response surface. The source uses only standard RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador services plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the Auto Provide FOM, object class, attribute, dimensional name, logical-time implementation, endpoint, provider configuration, and callback model. It verifies one overlapping source and subscriber region, time-constrained and time-regulating callbacks, one grouped provideAttributeValueUpdate callback with an empty request tag, a timestamped response issued from that callback through updateAttributeValues, queued delivery at a matching time advance, source-region and order metadata, a valid message-retraction handle, and the standard post-delivery retraction failure. It does not depend on private headers, registries, provider names, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional object publication, registration, subscription, time-management, timestamped update, and retraction services with FederateAmbassador discovery, provideAttributeValueUpdate, timestamped reflectAttributeValues, and time-management callbacks
